recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. No further core source change is needed for FHIR-22101 unless PA wants to revisit the broader Request.priority pattern or provide a concrete ConceptMap in a separate issue.
issue_request: FHIR-22101 asked PA to reconcile Appointment.priority with Request.priority by changing Appointment.priority from unsignedInt 0..1 to CodeableConcept 0..1 with an example ActPriority binding, and by updating comments to say the iCalendar priority is a localization that requires a ConceptMap to allocate the possible numeric value.
initial_application: Commit b29145fb873cb62d180e958f040f791ec733d405 applied the datatype and ActPriority example binding change and commented out numeric priority examples, but it left pre-change Appointment.priority comments and notes about numeric iCalendar priority and using an extension for CodeableConcept values.
additional_context: PA January 2021 WGM minutes confirm the 11-0-0 persuasive disposition and the same iCalendar localization/ConceptMap wording. Request.priority remains a required code pattern, so Appointment.priority intentionally remains a divergent mapping. FHIR-7964 is older background for the extension approach, but it is superseded by FHIR-22101 for the current R5+ source.
reconciliation: Updated the active Appointment StructureDefinition definition/comment, Appointment notes, Request mapping exception, and Appointment SVG tooltip to remove stale numeric/extension guidance and add the requested iCalendar localization and ConceptMap guidance.
source_changes: source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml: removed the stale numeric iCalendar parenthetical from Appointment.priority.definition and added the requested iCalendar localization/ConceptMap comment.
source/appointment/appointment-request-mapping-exceptions.xml: aligned the Request.priority mapping exception's Appointment.priority definition text with the revised active definition.
source/appointment/appointment-notes.xml: removed obsolete STU note text that still suggested using an extension for CodeableConcept priority values.
source/appointment/appointment.svg: aligned the checked-in Appointment diagram tooltip with the revised authoritative definition as part of the broader source fix.
